"text": "Your look for the holiday party starts with a rich brown blazer that adds structure to your figure, paired with soft camel satin trousers that let your legs move freely under the restaurant lights. The burgundy suede loafers ground the outfit in a deep, festive tone, while the bold red bag and gold earrings bring just the right amount of sparkle to make you stand out without overpowering the ensemble.",
"how_to_wear": [
"Wear the blazer open to keep the silhouette relaxed yet polished, letting the camel trousers shine as your foundation."
],

{n: "#254·22", text: "This tailored brown blazer features subtle shoulder accents that give a modern edge while maintaining a smooth, elegant line. The rich brown tone adds warmth to your look without overpowering it."},
{n: "#31·33", text: "The camel satin trousers offer a soft, fluid drape that skims the body gracefully. Their gentle sheen catches the light beautifully, adding a touch of luxury to your outfit."},
{n: "#226·06", text: "This red handbag features a sleek structure with a chain strap and clean lines. Its bold color creates a striking contrast against neutral tones."},
{n: "#306·31", text: "The delicate gold necklace is suspended from a fine chain with a small circular pendant, adding just the right amount of sparkle without overwhelming your look."},
{n: "#276·09", text: "These burgundy suede loafers feature a polished buckle detail and a low heel. Their soft texture adds comfort while their rich color grounds your outfit in sophistication."},
{n: "#225·31", text: "The gold earrings feature a classic clover design with white stone centers, offering timeless elegance that complements any neckline."}
]
